description: Backend: tạo ClosureRepository, NotificationRepository, ClosureService, NotificationService, ClosureController, NotificationController; cập nhật db.js (thêm read_at + sender_role vào notifications), ReportController (thêm approveBGHUnlock, sendNotification cho GVCN khi duyệt), server.js (đăng ký routes mới).
steps: 1. Cập nhật db.js: trong khối ALTER TABLE migration thứ hai, thêm `ALTER TABLE notifications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS read_at TIMESTAMPTZ;` và `ALTER TABLE notifications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS sender_role VARCHAR(30);` và `ALTER TABLE notifications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS related_class VARCHAR(30);` và `ALTER TABLE notifications ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS related_semester VARCHAR(10);`. File: src/config/db.js

2. Tạo src/repositories/NotificationRepository.js — import { querySafe as query, query as queryStrict } from '../config/db.js'. Xuất class NotificationRepository với: static async insert({ title, content, type, senderId, senderRole, recipients, relatedClass, relatedSemester }) → INSERT vào notifications, RETURNING *. static async findByRecipient(username) → SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE $1 = ANY(recipients) ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT 50. static async markRead(id) → UPDATE notifications SET read_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING *. static async findUnreadCount(username) → SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE $1 = ANY(recipients) AND read_at IS NULL. Dùng queryStrict cho INSERT/UPDATE, querySafe cho SELECT.

3. Tạo src/repositories/ClosureRepository.js — import { querySafe as query, query as queryStrict } from '../config/db.js'. Xuất class ClosureRepository với: static async upsert({ classId, className, gvcnName, semester, schoolYear }) → INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (class_id, semester, school_year) DO UPDATE SET status='submitted', submitted_at=NOW(), gvcn_name=EXCLUDED.gvcn_name RETURNING *. static async findByKey(classId, semester, schoolYear) → SELECT * FROM grade_book_closures WHERE class_id=$1 AND semester=$2 AND school_year=$3. static async updateStatus(classId, semester, schoolYear, status) → UPDATE grade_book_closures SET status=$4, approved_at=CASE WHEN $4='approved' THEN NOW() ELSE approved_at END WHERE class_id=$1 AND semester=$2 AND school_year=$3 RETURNING *. Dùng queryStrict cho write.

4. Tạo src/services/NotificationService.js — import NotificationRepository. Xuất class NotificationService: static async notify({ title, content, type, senderId, senderRole, recipients, relatedClass, relatedSemester }) → gọi NotificationRepository.insert(). static async getForUser(username) → gọi NotificationRepository.findByRecipient(username), map rows sang { id, title, content, type, senderRole, relatedClass, relatedSemester, sentAt, readAt }. static async markRead(id) → gọi NotificationRepository.markRead(id). static async getUnreadCount(username) → gọi NotificationRepository.findUnreadCount(username), parse thành số.

5. Tạo src/services/ClosureService.js — import ClosureRepository, NotificationService, GradeBookRepository (từ repositories/GradeBookRepository.js). Xuất class ClosureService: static async submitClosure({ classId, className, gvcnName, gvcnUsername, semester, schoolYear }) → (a) gọi ClosureRepository.upsert(), (b) không lock grade_books tại đây (lock khi BGH duyệt), (c) gọi NotificationService.notify({ title: `GVCN ${gvcnName} đã nộp sổ điểm lớp ${className}`, type: 'closure_submitted', senderId: gvcnUsername, senderRole: 'GVCN', recipients: ['BGH'], relatedClass: classId, relatedSemester: semester }), trả về closure DTO. static async requestUnlock({ classId, className, gvcnName, gvcnUsername, semester, schoolYear, reason }) → gọi NotificationService.notify({ title: `Xin mở khóa sổ điểm lớp ${className}`, content: reason, type: 'unlock_request', senderId: gvcnUsername, senderRole: 'GVCN', recipients: ['BGH'], relatedClass: classId, relatedSemester: semester }), trả về { success: true }. static async getStatus({ classId, semester, schoolYear }) → gọi ClosureRepository.findByKey(), trả về closure hoặc null.

6. Tạo src/controllers/ClosureController.js — import ClosureService. Xuất class ClosureController: static async submitClosure(req, res): POST /api/gradebook/closure/submit, lấy classId, className, gvcnName, semester, schoolYear từ req.body, gvcnUsername từ req.user.username, gọi ClosureService.submitClosure(), trả JSON success. static async requestUnlock(req, res): POST /api/gradebook/closure/request-unlock, lấy classId, className, gvcnName, semester, schoolYear, reason từ req.body, gọi ClosureService.requestUnlock(), trả JSON success. static async getStatus(req, res): GET /api/gradebook/closure?classId=&semester=&schoolYear=, gọi ClosureService.getStatus(), trả về closure hoặc null.

7. Tạo src/controllers/NotificationController.js — import NotificationService. Xuất class NotificationController: static async getNotifications(req, res): GET /api/notifications, lấy username = req.user.username, gọi NotificationService.getForUser(username), trả { success: true, data: [...] }. static async markRead(req, res): PATCH /api/notifications/:id/read, gọi NotificationService.markRead(req.params.id), trả { success: true }. static async getUnreadCount(req, res): GET /api/notifications/unread-count, gọi NotificationService.getUnreadCount(req.user.username), trả { success: true, count: N }.

8. Cập nhật ReportController.js: thêm import NotificationService ở đầu file. Thêm static method approveBGHUnlock(req, res): POST /api/reports/bgh/approve-unlock, lấy notificationId, classId, className, gvcnUsername, semester, schoolYear từ req.body, gọi ClosureRepository.updateStatus để reset về 'submitted' (mở lại cho GVCN chỉnh sửa), gọi NotificationService.markRead(notificationId), gọi NotificationService.notify({ title: `BGH đã duyệt mở khóa sổ điểm lớp ${className}`, type: 'unlock_approved', senderId: req.user.username, senderRole: 'BGH', recipients: [gvcnUsername], relatedClass: classId, relatedSemester: semester }), trả JSON success. Import ClosureRepository thêm vào đầu file. File: src/controllers/ReportController.js

9. Cập nhật server.js: thêm import { ClosureController } from './src/controllers/ClosureController.js' và import { NotificationController } from './src/controllers/NotificationController.js'. Đăng ký routes: app.get('/api/notifications/unread-count', authenticateToken, NotificationController.getUnreadCount); app.get('/api/notifications', authenticateToken, NotificationController.getNotifications); app.patch('/api/notifications/:id/read', authenticateToken, NotificationController.markRead); app.get('/api/gradebook/closure', authenticateToken, ClosureController.getStatus); app.post('/api/gradebook/closure/submit', authenticateToken, ClosureController.submitClosure); app.post('/api/gradebook/closure/request-unlock', authenticateToken, ClosureController.requestUnlock); app.post('/api/reports/bgh/approve-unlock', authenticateToken, requireBGH, ReportController.approveBGHUnlock). Đặt các route /api/gradebook/closure/* TRƯỚC route /api/gradebook/... đã có để tránh conflict. File: server.js
acceptance_criteria: Backend khởi động không có lỗi schema, bảng notifications có cột read_at, sender_role, related_class, related_semester
POST /api/gradebook/closure/submit với GVCN token → tạo bản ghi submitted trong grade_book_closures, tạo notification cho BGH
GET /api/gradebook/closure?classId=10A1&semester=HK1&schoolYear=2024-2025 → trả closure object hoặc null
POST /api/gradebook/closure/request-unlock → tạo notification type unlock_request cho BGH
GET /api/notifications với token BGH → trả danh sách notifications
POST /api/reports/bgh/approve-unlock → reset closure về submitted, gửi notification cho GVCN

Kiểm tra terminal log không có 'Error: Cannot find module' hay 'SyntaxError'
findings: Backend khởi động thành công, không có lỗi import hay DB INIT ERROR. Các bảng notifications có đủ cột mới: read_at, sender_role, related_class, related_semester. Các routes mới đã đăng ký: GET/POST /api/gradebook/closure/*, POST /api/gradebook/closure/request-unlock, GET/PATCH /api/notifications, GET /api/notifications/unread-count, POST /api/reports/bgh/approve-unlock. CORS đã thêm PATCH method. Server running PID 17724 trên port 8081. Files tạo mới: NotificationRepository.js, ClosureRepository.js, NotificationService.js, ClosureService.js, ClosureController.js, NotificationController.js. Files sửa đổi: db.js (4 ALTER TABLE mới), ReportController.js (import + approveBGHUnlock), server.js (2 imports + 7 routes mới + PATCH CORS).
